remarks: Special designer home in heart of the village of Springdale, perfectly renovated for today's everyday living and entertaining! Featuring a super stylish open kitchen-living-dining space with hardwood floors, you'll delight in function + flexibility in sun filled space!  Two main floor bedrooms and a romantic top floor primary bedroom suite offer an ideal blend of dreamy comfort and storage! The level, private back lawn invites family fun or upscale enjoyment under the shade of the pergola! Two exquisitely updated full baths, a1 car garage and extensive attic storage add to the ease of living here! Move right into this special home and further delight in this sought after spot, where you can walk to popular restaurants, shops, schools and the train.
